en: Sepia postcard showing a lively spa scene under a pavilion with columns and garlands in front of ornate late‑19th‑century buildings. Many visitors in Edwardian clothing gather around a fountain. Caption at the bottom reads "BAD PYRMONT - Stahlbrunnen." The reverse has German handwriting, a 5‑pfennig Deutsches Reich stamp, a Pyrmont postmark, the publisher credit, and a purple archive stamp.
